hold_text: Tier-2 by path AND by content: src/runtime/order_monitor.py is the reconciler that decides adoptions and closes on LIVE positions, and this diff changes which attributions it will write. R4 bars a Tier-2 diff from landing itself whatever its approval state, so this is held deliberately, no auto-merge request file is written, and no merge slot is claimed. THE APPROVAL BEING SOUGHT: one operator OK to arm the size-plausibility gate on the orphan-adopt attribution path, routed by the manager. WHAT A HUMAN SHOULD READ BEFORE APPROVING, because the approval is not the interesting part: (1) THE OBVIOUS IMPLEMENTATION FLATTENS LIVE POSITIONS, and I built it that way first before catching it. _reattach_adopted_orphans' own docstring says an UN-RECOVERABLE orphan is FLATTENED by the caller's per-account pass (_close_unattributable_orphan, operator decision 2026-06-15). So a gate that reports a refusal as a plain `None` is indistinguishable from `no candidate exists`, and would convert a journal mis-attribution into a live reduce-only close -- strictly worse than the defect it fixes. That is why the helper now returns a typed _OrphanAttribution and why the flatten probe is wired to the gate NOT to refuse anything but so that a refusal is never mistaken for `no candidate`. tests::test_a_refusal_is_distinguishable_from_no_candidate pins it and is mutation-checked. (2) THE GATE IS OPT-IN PER CALL SITE, which is a safety property rather than a convenience: the back-compat wrapper takes no position_size and therefore cannot refuse, so _sweep_local_pnl_for_unpriced's opportunistic re-link (which writes only order_package_id, never strategy_name) is untouched by construction. (3) THE REFUSAL IS PERMISSIVE ON IGNORANCE: no_history and unreadable do NOT refuse, deliberately, because refusing on 1-2 samples would bare-orphan a young strategy's first adopt on no evidence -- and a bare orphan is not free either, it runs on a static stop with no monitor(). Only size_implausible refuses. (4) THE BAND (2.0x around the claimed strategy's own observed range on that symbol) IS CHOSEN, NOT DERIVED, and n=5 judgeable adopts is a small population -- what carries it is that the verdict is robust: the two mis-attributions sit 8.4x and 21.5x outside range, and a parametrized test shows every band from 1.5 to 8.0 gives the same 5 verdicts.
why: Fixes BL-20260908-THE-ORPHAN-ADOPT-REATTACH-WRITES-A-STRATEGY-NAME-IT-CANNOT-SUPPORT-AND-THAT-STRATEGY-THEN-ACTS-ON-THE-ROW (severity critical, open). _recover_orphan_order_package matched on (symbol, direction, entry_price) with NO size term and took the first candidate within 2%; the adopt then wrote that strategy_name into trades.strategy_name, after which THAT STRATEGY'S monitor() ran against the position. Adds src/runtime/orphan_attribution.py -- a pure, separately-testable decision with four never-collapsed states (supported / size_implausible / no_history / unreadable) -- and consults it at the two sites that WRITE strategy_name. On refusal the row stays a BARE orphan, the honest state 6 of 13 adopts already carry; it never proposes a second candidate. ALSO CORRECTS A FALSE DOCSTRING (field beats comment): the matcher claimed its entry-price tolerance meant `we never mis-attribute a position to the wrong strategy (which would apply the wrong exit rules)` -- measured false. EXPLICITLY NOT IN SCOPE, and each for a stated reason: the over-cover trigger (covered_qty is deliberately side-blind because it feeds the over-cover TRIP, the union of same-book pile-up AND other-book legs; narrowing it would make the second condition go silent); the rows[0] fix (already shipped as 46e1efb1f / #11435, and the backlog row says bundling would make one operator decision cover two order-path changes); and the disposition of the two existing wrong rows 5448/5453, which is a money-DB write and is PROPOSED, not done. No order was placed, modified or cancelled on any account.

does_not_close_the_row: This PR CANNOT close BL-20260908. Its resolution_criteria requires PROVEN BY an observed adopt whose re-attach DECLINED on a quantity mismatch and left the row bare, READ FROM THE LIVE JOURNAL -- and says in terms `not by a unit test, which cannot reproduce the venue state that produces a candidate package`. 24 tests pass and two mutations are caught; none of that is a fleet observation. It also owes the disposition of rows 5448 and 5453, which is a separate money-DB decision.
